contact.name: Michele Clamp
contact.evidence_quote: Welcome to Michele Clamp Art - Michele Clamp Art ... I’m a full-time watercolor artist and teacher. I love painting and sharing with people all that I’ve learned over the years. I post regularly on my blog and run classes and workshops throughout the year. Some of my work is available for sale and I am honored by everyone who takes one into their homes. Also my husband says I buy far too many brushes. Recently I developed the ChromaMagic app which has transformed my ability to see color and is now available for everyone on iOS, Android, and Window
